name: Content calendar campaign
description: Daily post from a content backlog sheet. OpenHuman drafts each post from your brief, queues it for your approval, and posts at most one per day across LinkedIn, Twitter, etc.

proposed_workflows.name: Content calendar — daily publisher
proposed_workflows.description: Daily 10am: pick the next unpublished post from the sheet, draft the platform-specific copy, queue for approval.

config.prompt: Draft the next scheduled post. The row from the content backlog is: {{record}}. Use the `channel` column to choose voice (LinkedIn = professional, Twitter = punchy). Use `title` + `draft` as source material. Keep under platform character limits. Send via the matching connection — the runtime will queue for approval before publishing.

rationale_at_seed: Throttle 1/day caps publishing cadence even if the sheet has 100 ready rows.
for_each with max_per_run=1 + filter `posted=false` pulls exactly the next post.
DraftAndApprove gives the user final say on tone before anything ships.
Content backlog → daily-pace publishing is a classic Phase 4 pattern. Throttle ensures consistency without rep-handling.
Single sub-workflow at MVP; engagement-digest workflow is the obvious extension when the user wants metrics.
Defaults to LinkedIn for the channel; user swaps in their preferred platform via the connection picker after [Use template].
